description:
modules/traegerview — GET /traeger/schools/daily-attendance (#4717):
the Träger's schools and their federal state (one batched settings read)
before the administrative transaction, then the Träger row, the school IDs,
the rows of the schools in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, their care days per child
and their status days for the whole school set. Flat in the number of
schools. The access log entry each school with children gets runs in that
school's tenant unit and is counted apart (one insert per school).
